technical_and_design_decisions: Extend Spring Cloud Stream's BinderFactory and configuration framework to allow registering and configuring multiple binder instances/connection factories within the same application context.
Refactor stream definition parsing and container lifecycle management in the Admin UI/runtime to correctly handle escape sequences and embedded quote characters during container shutdown.
Utilize standard JUnit 5 and Spring Test framework infrastructure for SPI unit tests and mock-based SPI integration tests.
Document BOM template concepts in standard Markdown/Asciidoc within the project's official reference documentation.
assumptions: Development and testing will be performed in a single-developer environment with existing CI test environments available for Lattice, Cloud Foundry (CC), and YARN integration runs.
No major structural breaking changes are required for existing single-binder Spring Cloud Stream applications.
Third-party drivers and services (e.g., Oracle JDBC, HDFS, YARN, Lattice) are mocked or accessible in test suites via containerized or embedded mocks.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing SPI test infrastructure, document BOM template requirements, and design the multi-binder architecture for Spring Cloud Stream and the container shutdown fix.
Write comprehensive reference documentation and sample configurations for BOM templates and dynamic inclusion of external libraries.

activities.activity_name: Enhance Integration Test Coverage for SPIs (U2, U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement automated integration tests for Lattice, CC (Cloud Foundry), and YARN SPIs suitable for CI pipeline execution.

activities.activity_description: Add comprehensive unit tests covering edge cases and interface contracts for Lattice and YARN SPIs.

activities.activity_name: Fix Container Shutdown Issue for Complex Stream Definitions (U7)
activities.activity_description: Debug and fix stream definition string escaping/parsing issue preventing container shutdown from Admin UI, and add regression tests.
Implement multi-binder configuration, binder resolution logic, and connection factory mapping in Spring Cloud Stream, along with unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: CI Pipeline Validation and Final Quality Assurance
activities.activity_description: Execute full CI regression suite, verify integration test stability across all targeted SPIs, and conduct final code review.
